g.text: 20-file corpus, M2 Ultra 128GB (Mac14,14), 30s windows; bars are 95% file-bootstrap CIs of the paired difference. The default is the cheapest build with no resolved loss against bf16: 4bit's English loss resolves, bf16's Japanese gain does not. Source: voxtral-v1.md.
